meta.title: {{app}}: inventory forecasting for Shopify
meta.description: Know when every product runs out and how many to reorder. Forecasts explained in plain words, bundles included, flat price from $0.

hero.title: Know when every product runs out, and how many to reorder.
hero.lead: {{app}} forecasts the stock-out date of every variant and tells you when to order and how much. Every number comes with the math behind it, so you can check it and change it.
hero.note: Free plan for up to 50 products · Ready in about 5 minutes · No contract

explained.title: Every number explained
explained.body: Sales windows, out-of-stock days left out, seasonality, lead time and safety stock, in plain words.

price.title: Flat, small price
price.body: Free, or {{price}} a month. Never a share of your sales, no contract, and your price never goes up.

quiet.title: Quiet by design
quiet.body: At most one email a day, only when something needs ordering. No upsell pop-ups.

selfServe.title: No demo call needed

features.heading: Everything you need to reorder on time
features.lead: Built for small and growing Shopify stores that buy from suppliers and don't want a spreadsheet or an enterprise contract.

forecast.title: Stock-out date for every variant
forecast.body: A blend of your last 7, 30 and 90 days of sales, with out-of-stock days removed and last year's season taken into account.

reorder.title: When to order, and how many
reorder.body: Reorder point from lead time and safety stock, incoming stock subtracted, rounded to minimum orders and case packs.

explain.title: “Why this number?”
explain.body: Each forecast shows the sales days used, the days left out and the settings applied. Disagree? Adjust the sales rate, lead time or safety stock.

bundles.title: Bundles that make sense
bundles.body: Sales of a bundle count toward each component, so the parts you actually stock are forecast correctly.

suppliers.title: Suppliers and lead times
suppliers.body: Lead time, order days and order cycle per supplier. Create suppliers from your Shopify vendors in one click.

stocky.title: Moving from Stocky?
stocky.body: Import your purchase order CSV: suppliers are created, products linked and lead times measured from your real orders.

planning.title: Plan ahead
planning.body: A 12-week purchase plan, a monthly buying budget, sales events like Black Friday, and “what if sales grow 20%?”.

insights.title: See where money is stuck
insights.body: Slow and excess stock, ABC classes by revenue, sales lost while out of stock, and how accurate past forecasts were.

explain.heading: A forecast you can read, not a black box
explain.lead: Most forecasting tools give you a number. {{app}} tells you where it comes from, in the same words you would use.
explain.point1: See which sales days were counted and which out-of-stock days were left out.
explain.point2: See the lead time, safety stock and supplier rules behind every reorder quantity.
explain.point3: Expecting a promotion or a quiet month? Change the sales rate and watch the suggestion update.
explain.alt: Product forecast with its explanation in {{app}}

faq.heading: Questions

data.q: What data does the app keep?
data.a: Only daily sales totals per product, your catalog and stock levels, and what you enter. No customer names, emails or addresses, and raw orders are not stored.

languages.q: Which languages does the app speak?
languages.a: English, Vietnamese, Spanish, German, French and Portuguese. It follows your Shopify admin language, or you can pick one in Settings.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what {{app}} (the "app") reads from your Shopify store, what it keeps, and how to have it deleted. The app is used by Shopify merchants; it has no contact with your customers.

reads.heading: What the app reads from Shopify
reads.products: titles, SKU, barcode, vendor, product type, price, unit cost, status.
reads.inventory: available and incoming quantities per location, and your locations.
reads.orders: only the quantity sold and returned of each variant, the order date and, for stores with several locations, which location fulfilled it, to build daily sales totals. The app never requests customer names, emails, addresses, phone numbers or payment details.
reads.store: shop domain, name, currency, time zone and contact email (used to email you when no alert email is set).

stores.heading: What the app stores
stores.sales: Daily sales totals per variant (units sold, units returned, end-of-day stock) for up to 400 days. Raw orders are not stored.
stores.catalog: Your product catalog details listed above, current stock levels, and the forecasts computed from them.
stores.entered: What you enter in the app: suppliers (name, email, lead time), settings, bundles and forecast adjustments.
stores.shop: Your shop domain, an encrypted Shopify access token, your plan and the email address you choose for alerts.
stores.emails: A log of emails the app sent for you (recipient, subject, date, delivery status; not the message), kept 180 days, and for purchase orders you email to a supplier, the products and quantities ordered.
stores.noCustomers: The app stores no personal data of your customers.
stores.noCustomersBody: Requests Shopify forwards on behalf of your customers (data requests, erasure requests) therefore have nothing to return or delete.

use.heading: How it is used
use.body: Only to provide the app: forecasting, reorder suggestions, the emails you turn on, and support. The data is not sold, shared for advertising, or used to train AI models. No tracking or advertising cookies are used; the app runs inside the Shopify admin and signs requests with Shopify session tokens.

providers.heading: Service providers
providers.body: The app runs on a hosting provider (servers and database), sends email through an email delivery provider, and reports technical errors (without customer data; access tokens are masked) to an internal monitoring channel. They process data only on our behalf to run the app.

retention.heading: Retention and deletion
retention.uninstall: When you uninstall the app, its access token is removed immediately and billing stops.
retention.erase: 48 hours after uninstall, Shopify asks the app to erase your shop's data and everything is deleted (sales totals, catalog, forecasts, suppliers, settings, email log). Reinstalling within those 48 hours keeps your data.
retention.sooner: To have your data deleted sooner, or for a copy of it, email

security.heading: Security
security.body: Traffic is encrypted (HTTPS). Access tokens are encrypted at rest. Webhooks from Shopify are verified by signature.

forecast.a: Every product has a "Why this number?" explanation: the sales windows used (7, 30 and 90 days), the out-of-stock days left out, seasonality, bundles, lead time and safety stock. You can adjust the sales rate, lead time and safety stock yourself.

noForecast.q: Why don't I see forecasts yet?
noForecast.a: Right after install the app imports your orders and stock in the background (a progress bar shows it). A store without orders gets forecasts once it starts selling; products without sales show "no sales yet".

stocky.q: I'm moving from Stocky. Can I keep my suppliers?
stocky.a: Yes. Export your purchase orders from Stocky as CSV and import them in Suppliers → Import from Stocky. The app creates your suppliers, links products and works out each supplier's lead time.

billing.q: How does billing work? Can I cancel anytime?
billing.a: Plans are a flat monthly or yearly price billed on your Shopify invoice: no share of your sales, no contract. Your price never goes up while you stay on your plan. Uninstalling the app cancels billing automatically.
